confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors are medium-high confidence: several aggregators agree on SEK ranges, but they are crowdsourced or modelled, not official menu surveys. Beer, cocktail and wine anchors are medium-low: they rely on Stockholm bar guides and a Swedish national range, and Gothenburg venue prices may differ. Accommodation anchors are low-medium: they are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the city context, with no live listings inspected and no accommodation searches run. Every USD conversion uses an approximate 0.105 USD per SEK, taken from the aggregator figures. The FX observation is the RBA rate for 2026-11-18; the 2026-11-19 fix was not yet published at the time of search.
comparable_city_reasoning: Gothenburg food and drink anchors use Swedish aggregator data (CityCost, Cities Insider, mylifeelsewhere, Routes North, Rough Guides) with Stockholm bar guidance as a proxy for cocktail and wine prices. Accommodation anchors use a general knowledge estimate for a mid-sized Swedish tourism city with similar pricing to other Swedish cities.
